# plan_review_chain
DSH orchestrator's multi-step plan-approval chain required by dsh/AGENTS.md "Plan Review" section.

## Trigger
- The orchestrate tool's op enum is only full|tool|list; there is no standalone plan_review op.
- Triggered via op:"full" with the full plan text inlined in the request (PLAN_REVIEW wording).
- planner is a pure-text model with no disk access and cannot review file paths, so plan text must be inlined.

## Chain Structure
- planner produces the initial plan.
- plan_reviewer (preferred: cursor/grok-4.7@256k) reviews the plan.
- glm-5.3-flash produces the final summary.

## Timing and Timeout
- Each step takes 20~70s; full chain usually 1~3 min, all ok:true per .costs.jsonl.
- Orchestrator 300s timeout: grok-4.7 reviewing a long plan may exceed 5 min and report "python call timeout (300000ms)"; retry or shorten the plan.

updates.after:
- Requires the model to first produce a markdown plan (listing tasks/bugs with causes and distributed implementation) rather than just creating a todo list and executing.
- The plan is reviewed by a senior model (e.g. grok); if rejected, it is sent back to the main model for revision until approved.
- The final draft requires explicit user confirmation before implementation starts.
- AGENTS.md requires invoking the orchestrator for plan approval; the orchestrate tool's op enum is only full|tool|list, so plan_review is triggered via op:"full" with the full plan text inlined (planner is a pure-text model with no disk access); reviewer pool preferred: cursor/grok-4.7@256k.
- This requirement is written into the "Plan Review" section of dsh/AGENTS.md and takes effect globally.
